summary.short: Georgia Public Service Commission order (Docket 44280) approving revisions to Georgia Power's Rules and Regulations for electric service. Allows the company to impose minimum billing requirements and longer contract terms on new customers with 100 MW or more of load, with conditions protecting existing customers. Effective from 1 February 2025 for the added paragraphs.
summary.long: Order of 23 January 2025 approving revisions that Georgia Power Company filed on 11 December 2024 under O.C.G.A. § 46-2-25(a). The revisions, in Section A (General Rules) and Section D (Transmission or Wholesale Distribution Line Extension and Service Connection Regulations), apply to customers with an expected peak demand of 100 MW or greater at one or more premises on one tract or contiguous tracts of land. For these customers the company may require additional terms and conditions, including minimum billing requirements and a longer contract term, to recover costs of serving or preparing to serve them. Section D also allows the company to require performance and credit provisions, and, on contract termination, payment of costs including distribution, transmission and generation costs. The Commission adopted Staff's modifications: the company must exercise its discretion so as to protect existing customers from bearing any costs of adding these large customers; provide Staff with the terms, conditions and criteria before using them for contracting; file complete contracts within 30 days of execution; and make compliance filings of the relevant tariffs. The Commission retains jurisdiction to modify the rules. The order states no penalties.

enforcement.note: The order and the approved rule text contain no fines, criminal penalties, licence revocation, benefit clawback or blocking. Section A (General Rules), page 1.11, includes a Company right to suspend service for altered metering or uncompensated use. That paragraph predates this docket and is not among the revisions approved here, so it is not coded as an enforcement regime.
